text: Yo ɓee tultulɓe ka jihaadi e ɓen tuubanooɓe Alla anndu, wonnde Alla jaɓanay jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen ruttotooɓe e Makko tuubuubuyee, e wonnde O jaɓay sadakkuuji ɗine hoore ko O yondiniiɗo e majji, O yoɓa sakkiiɗo on e sadaka makko on, e wonnde Kanko Seniiɗo on, ko O Jaɓanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
